stories.title: Northbound I-205 closed at Abernethy Bridge this weekend while crews move bridge deck
stories.summary: Crews will use hydraulic jacks to lift the entire northbound bridge deck and move it eight feet to one side, as part of the ongoing project to widen the bridge.

stories.title: Nippon Dynawave victims’ families pursue justice as investigation reveals 75 workplace safety violations
stories.summary: Some families of Nippon Dynawave victims are seeking justice after state investigators uncovered dozens of safety violations and issued millions in fines.

stories.title: Berkly Catton scores a hat trick as the Kraken beat the Canucks 5-1
stories.summary: Berkly Catton got his first NHL hat trick, helping the Seattle Kraken end a three-game losing streak with a 5-1 victory over the Vancouver Canucks.

stories.title: Woman faces murder charge after stabbing ex in front of 3-year-old son in Clatsop County
stories.summary: Deputies responded to a home in the Knappa area and found a man with life-threatening injuries, who died at the scene. His ex-partner was taken into custody.

stories.title: King tides return to the Oregon Coast next week, but flooding may happen sooner
stories.summary: Visitors have the chance to catch the high tides from Sunday, Nov. 23, to Thursday, Nov. 27.

stories.title: Remains identified as Battle Ground man reported missing in 2018
stories.summary: The Clark County Sheriff's Office said there is no evidence of foul play in Bob Sarkkinen's death, closing the case after more than seven years.

stories.title: Silverton Christmas Market returns with millions of lights, ice skating and holiday cheer
stories.summary: The German-style Christmas market is back for its sixth year at the Oregon Garden Resort.

stories.title: Families of Nippon Dynawave tank failure victims react to workplace safety investigation findings
stories.summary: Family members of the deadly tank failure victims reacted to new safety investigation findings, and push for accountability and stronger workplace protections.

stories.title: Nippon Dynawave fined over $10M for 'egregious' safety violations; investigators refer criminal charges
stories.summary: The findings of the workplace safety investigation are part of a larger effort to uncover exactly what went wrong that day.

stories.title: MAX train derails after hitting car in Hillsboro
stories.summary: Hillsboro police said no one was injured, but the Southeast 10th Avenue and Southeast Washington Street intersection will be closed through the night.

stories.title: 'Wildwood' hitting Portland movie theaters for free this Thanksgiving
stories.summary: A love letter to Portland and handmade art, 'Wildwood' will be playing at several theaters across the metro area for free on Sunday, Nov. 29.

stories.title: Oregon wines shine as 4 make Wine Spectator's top 100 list
stories.summary: Four Oregon wines, including three pinot noirs, have made Wine Spectator's top 100 list, highlighting the Willamette Valley's prestige in the winemaking world.
